# Devashish Trehan

> Senior Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience building production-grade web applications.

## Skills

React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, frontend architecture, performance optimization, and responsive web development.

## Projects

- [WPT Play](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt-play): Built a shared authentication module and cross-application communication layer to connect multiple micro-frontends.
- [World Poker Tour](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt): Led the migration to Next.js, developed reusable page structures, integrated Strapi content, and improved loading performance.
- [College Disha](https://devtrehan.in/projects/college-disha): Migrated a legacy PHP frontend to Next.js, defining its architecture and rendering strategy while improving performance by around 25%.
- [Sosh Nft](https://devtrehan.in/projects/sosh-nft): Improved the existing application's UI and UX, completed key frontend features, and integrated backend APIs and blockchain services.
- [Casino Lobby](https://devtrehan.in/projects/casino-lobby): Developed a widget-based lobby architecture, integrated embedded application communication, and optimized API data handling.
- [Casino CMS](https://devtrehan.in/projects/casino-cms): Built a drag-and-drop lobby builder with collection editing, localization workflows, bulk operations, and role-based access control.
- [WPT Global](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt-global): Built reusable frontend components, integrated analytics, and developed an internal tool to validate translation files.
- [WPTG CMS](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wptg-cms): Extended Strapi with custom content collections, locale duplication plugins, and application-specific API logic and validation.
- [WPTG Promo](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wptg-promo): Developed a reusable widget-based page architecture and migrated the application from Vue.js to Next.js.
- [WPT CMS](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt-cms): Customized Strapi content models and integrated CMS data with the frontend to support website content requirements.
- [My Portfolio](https://devtrehan.in/projects/dev-portfolio): Designed and developed my portfolio with reusable components, responsive layouts, and structured project and experience data.
- [Distinct](https://devtrehan.in/projects/distinct): Developed and maintained the marketing website, translating designs into responsive layouts and interactive frontend components.
- [GamaVrs](https://devtrehan.in/projects/gamavrs): Developed admin workflows for avatar management, user administration, CMS features, role-based access, and dashboard forms.
- [Moments NFT](https://devtrehan.in/projects/moment-nft): Developed core NFT auction workflows, reusable UI components, responsive layouts, and backend API integrations.
